comment.body:
The ads scripts on this site can be already covered by

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/5e26d5722c5ae40b2846257e04c60622aeb28e74/BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt#L22926-L22927

and

```adblock
/\.cloudfront\.net\/\?[a-z][a-z][a-z][a-z]?[a-z]?=[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]?$/$script,xmlhttprequest,third-party
```

`$third-party,script` should only be used when there are no other ways to cover the ads scripts via regex. Also, Safari itself can't distinguish 1st-party scripts from iframe contexts, and will treat them all as 3rd-party scripts, even though those scripts are considered 1st-party to the iframes. Which would cause breakages for websites that use iframes a lot, like streaming sites. You can see the other domains in that rule are mostly manga sites which usually don't have other iframes on the site.
